data.name: Muaaz
data.gender_notes: Muaaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who strives or aspires to attain something, often in the face of adversity or hardship. The name Muaaz carries the meaning “Striving, Seeking, or Struggling” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Muaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody striving, seeking, or struggling and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouraging one to persevere through life's challenges and continue the spiritual journey towards self-improvement and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Muaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Striving, Seeking, or Struggling.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muaaz total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مُعَاذ
in_arabic.meaning: محفوظ شدہ، اللہ تعالیٰ کی حفاظت میں رہنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُعَاذ نام کا مطلب ہے محفوظ شدہ یا اللہ تعالیٰ کی حفاظت میں رہنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کسی قیمتی یا大切 چیز کو محفوظ کرنا۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی اس نام کا ذکر آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ آل عمران میں مُعَاذ بن جبل کا نام ملتا ہے، جو رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے صحابیوں میں سے ایک تھے۔

in_urdu.name: معاذ
in_urdu.meaning: محفوظ شدہ، اللہ کی حفاظت میں رہنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: معاذ نام کا مطلب ہے محفوظ شدہ یا اللہ کی حفاظت میں رہنے والا۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے کسی قیمتی یا大切 چیز کو محفوظ کرنا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں یہ نام خاص طور پر مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کے صحابی معاذ بن جبل سے منسلک ہے، جو ایک ممتاز عالم اور مبلغ تھے۔

in_hindi.meaning: संरक्षित, अल्लाह की सुरक्षा में रहने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआज़ नाम का अर्थ है संरक्षित या अल्लाह की सुरक्षा में रहने वाला। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से निकला है और इसका अर्थ है किसी महत्वपूर्ण या मूल्यवान चीज़ को सुरक्षित करना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण है क्योंकि यह पैगंबर मुहम्मद صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم के साथी मुआज़ बिन जबल से जुड़ा है, जो एक प्रमुख विद्वान और प्रचारक थे।

in_english.name: Muaaz
in_english.meaning: Protected, preserved, or safeguarded by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Muaaz is derived from the Arabic root 'aadh' which means to protect or preserve. It signifies someone who is protected or safeguarded by Allah. The name holds historical significance as it is associated with Muaz bin Jabal, a companion of Prophet Muhammad, who played a vital role in spreading Islam. The name Muaaz symbolizes spiritual protection, piety, and devotion.

Muaaz is a name given to individuals who are determined, courageous, and strive for excellence and success in their personal and professional lives. The name carries a sense of resilience and perseverance, encouraging the bearer to overcome challenges and never give up on their aspirations, no matter how difficult they may seem.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, striving towards Allah (God) and seeking His pleasure is one of the primary objectives of a believer's life. The name "Muaaz" holds a spiritual significance in that it is a reminder of the importance of always striving towards Allah and His guidance, no matter what hardships or obstacles stand in the way. It is a call to be diligent in one's faith and to always aspire for a closer relationship with the Divine. Additionally, the name inspires the believer to be a source of motivation and support for others on their spiritual journey, encouraging them to also strive towards Allah with determination and resilience.
